changelog: - **The game examples have a group of their own.** File ▸ Templates lists the desalination and coffee roastery examples, then Games ›, which shows the MMO and the four gacha examples in their place, with a row back to the Templates; Escape or Arrow Left goes back too, and the next Escape closes the menu. The phone's Templates sheet does the same, and each example there is now a full-width row with its name on one line and its description under it, so a long name no longer breaks over several lines. Help ▸ Example notes lists the game examples under a Games heading. Opening an example is unchanged.
